title: News tab and a rebuilt site navigation
items: Added a News tab backed by news.d/ — one file per post — with a Post news form, an add-news workflow that opens a pull request, and tools/add-news.py for local posts.
Moved Star on GitHub and Suggest a repo out of the navigation into the hero; the views are now a real tab bar, and the catalog Filters button lives in the catalog toolbar beside the search box.
